dict.string: Your precise location is used to calculate turn-by-turn directions, show your location on the map, and help improve the map.
Please enable precise location. Turn-by-turn directions only work when precise location data is available.
We need access to your camera for AR navigation with real-time text detection to help you navigate better.
We need access to save photos you take during navigation to your photo library.
Atenea uses local network to connect staff with users in emergency situations using NearbyInteraction for precise distance and direction.
